core_obligations: Reformulate kernel membership via invertible coherent triples
Produce the polynomial bound on Euler characteristics
Bound P(n) linearly via local duality and a nonvanishing section

proof_roadmap.step: Extend L over U_0 to a coherent triple and apply Proposition hilbert-triple / Lemma nonnegative-chi-triple
Relate chi of the triple to the length of the image of H2_m(M) -> H2_m(A/fA) via the long exact sequences of local cohomology

Treat the finite-length case, then in general use Matlis duality, the support analysis of Ext^{-2}, assumption (4), and the section t from properties-lemma-quasi-affine-invertible-nonvanishing-section to get the linear bound

difficulty_reason: The retained proof is a complete argument: it identifies kernel membership with extendability to an invertible coherent triple, uses the Hilbert polynomial machinery of Proposition hilbert-triple and Lemma nonnegative-chi-triple to produce a polynomial P bounding the Euler characteristics, then proves a linear upper bound for P(n) by analysing the map on H2_m via Matlis duality (dualizing complex, support of Ext with depth-dimension inequalities ruled out by assumption (4)) and a carefully chosen nonvanishing section t; the special finite-length case is worked out first to organize the general bound. Retained author proof at lines 8751-8904.
